mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, batch_code, batch_name, batch_status, collect_start_time, collect_end_time, created_at, updated_at FROM herb_batch WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND batch_status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY COALESCE(collect_start_time, created_at), id

SELECT id, batch_id, task_id, plant_height, stem_diameter, temperature, humidity, soil_moisture, soil_ph, light, leaf_color, flowering_status, sample_weight, review_status, submitted_at, collected_at, created_at, updated_at FROM herb_growth_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(collected_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, batch_id, task_id, plant_height, stem_diameter, temperature, humidity, soil_moisture, soil_ph, light, leaf_color, flowering_status, sample_weight, review_status, submitted_at, collected_at, created_at, updated_at FROM herb_growth_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(collected_at, created_at), id

SELECT i.id AS imageId, i.image_type AS imageType, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM herb_identification_result r WHERE r.image_id = i.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS recognitionReady, COALESCE(i.collected_at, i.created_at) AS uploadTime FROM herb_batch b JOIN herb_batch_image bi ON bi.batch_id = b.id AND bi.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.bind_status = 'bound' JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = bi.image_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.batch_status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY COALESCE(i.collected_at, i.created_at), i.id

SELECT b.id AS batchId, i.id AS imageId, i.image_type AS imageType, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM herb_identification_result r WHERE r.image_id = i.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS recognitionReady, COALESCE(i.collected_at, i.created_at) AS uploadTime FROM herb_batch b JOIN herb_batch_image bi ON bi.batch_id = b.id AND bi.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.bind_status = 'bound' JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = bi.image_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.batch_status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY b.id, COALESCE(i.collected_at, i.created_at), i.id
